entities.summary: Antonio Agustín y Albanell (1517–1586), also referred to as Augustinus, was a Spanish Humanist historian, jurist, theologian, scholar, bibliophile, and Roman Catholic archbishop of Tarragona, who pioneered the historical research of the sources of canon law.
